concept: Organizations SCP: maximum permissions for member accounts
tests: Which feature restricts the services available to an organization's member accounts regardless of IAM policies inside the accounts.
expected: Service Control Policies in AWS Organizations — set the maximum allowed permissions for accounts (guardrails); IAM can't exceed them. Triggers: "member accounts", "regardless of IAM policies", "guardrail".
why_not: Permission boundaries — on a principal within one account; resource-based policies — access to individual resources; IAM Access Analyzer finds external access but denies nothing.
